# iboss_blocklist_entry (Resource)

Manages one entry on a security group's block list.

This resource is non-authoritative: other entries on the same list are left alone. Every argument forces replacement because the API documents add and delete operations but no update. Timed (expiring) entries are not supported, and `create_before_destroy` cannot be used because the replacement would collide with the existing entry.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "iboss_security_group" "students" {
  name = "Students"
}

resource "iboss_blocklist_entry" "games" {
  group_number = data.iboss_security_group.students.group_number
  url          = "games.example.com"
  note         = "Managed by Terraform"
}

resource "iboss_blocklist_entry" "pattern" {
  group_number = data.iboss_security_group.students.group_number
  url          = ".*\\.unblocked-games\\.example$"
  is_regex     = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_number` (Number) Security (filtering) group number whose block list holds the entry. Sent as `currentPolicyBeingEdited`. Look it up by name with the `iboss_security_group` data source.
- `url` (String) URL, domain, or pattern to add, for example `example.com`. The entry is located by exact match, or by a single match that differs only in letter case or a trailing `/`.

### Optional

- `apply_keyword_and_safe_search` (Boolean) Apply keyword filtering and safe search to this entry (`applyKeywordAndSafeSearch`). Server default applies when omitted.
- `direction` (Number) Traffic direction code (`direction`). The documented examples use `0` and `2`; the meaning of each value is not documented, so it is passed through unchanged.
- `end_port` (Number) Last port of the range the entry applies to (`endPort`). The documented examples use `0`.
- `global` (Boolean) Global entry flag (`global`). Server default applies when omitted.
- `is_regex` (Boolean) Treat `url` as a regular expression (`isRegex`). Server default applies when omitted.
- `note` (String) Free-text note stored with the entry. Changing it replaces the entry; no update operation is documented.
- `priority` (Number) Entry priority (`priority`).
- `start_port` (Number) First port of the range the entry applies to (`startPort`). The documented examples use `0`.
- `weight` (Number) Entry weight (`weight`).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier in the form `<group_number>/<url>`.
- `resource_id` (String) Associated resource identifier reported by the API (`resourceId`).
- `type` (Number) Entry type as reported by the API (`type`). Read-only; the meaning of its values is not documented.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import an existing entry using <group_number>/<url>.
terraform import iboss_blocklist_entry.games 2/games.example.com
```
